# NEW 2026-11-22 v13.0 Worker 2 (Slot 97 oe_afr_): Africa Three Independent Civilization Axes — Solomonic Ethiopia, Mali/Songhai Timbuktu & Kilwa/Swahili/Zimbabwe (0 new rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v130_africa.py; edit the generator, not this file.

namespace = oe_afr

# 1. Axis 1: 1450 Council of Debre Mitmaq & Mashafa Berhan
oe_afr.1 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_afr.1.title
	desc = oe_afr.1.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_afr_zara_yaqob_council.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	option = {
		name = oe_afr.1.a
		ai_chance = { base = 80 }
		oe_afr_apply_mitmaq_concord = yes
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_afr.1.b
		ai_chance = { base = 20 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_afr_chewa_highland_muster_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
		add_stability = 6
		add_legitimacy = 10
	}
}

oe_afr.6 = {

		add_gold = -80
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_afr_gondarine_renaissance_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
		add_prestige = 18
		if = {
			limit = { owns = location:gonder }
			location:gonder = {
				create_art = {
					type = work_of_art_type:monument
					quality = 80
					key = oe_afr_art_gondar_fasil_ghebbi
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			capital ?= {
				create_art = {
					type = work_of_art_type:monument
					quality = 80
					key = oe_afr_art_gondar_fasil_ghebbi
				}
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_afr.6.b
		ai_chance = { base = 25 }
		add_gold = 160
		add_stability = 6
	}
}
